const words = ["apple", "kiwi"];
const lengths = new Map<string, number>(words.map((w) => [w, w.length]));
console.log(lengths);

const scores: Record<string, number> = { alice: 3, bob: 5 };
const doubled = new Map<string, number>(Object.entries(scores).map(([name, score]) => [name, score * 2]));
console.log(doubled);

function loose(pairs: Iterable<[string, number]>): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const [, value] of pairs) total += value;
  return total;
}
function strict(pairs: Iterable<readonly [string, number]> | null): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const [, value] of pairs ?? []) total += value;
  return total;
}
console.log(loose(words.map((w) => [w, 1])), strict(words.map((w) => [w, 2])));
